title: Finish user stories
body:
**As a** developer
**I need** a prioritized backlog of testable user stories
**So that** the team can implement and verify the project systematically

### Details and assumptions
- Use the public repository and .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/user-story.md.
- Track the thirteen course stories and the authentication research item.

### Acceptance criteria
```gherkin
Given the project repository exists
When I open its issues
Then at least eight stories use the shared template and have a planning label
```

title: Initialize and populate MongoDB
body:
**As a** developer
**I need** a MongoDB database with the supplied sixteen gifts
**So that** the API has realistic starting data

### Details and assumptions
- Database: secondChance; collection: secondChanceItems.
- A second seed must not duplicate or overwrite existing gifts.

### Acceptance criteria
```gherkin
Given MongoDB is running
When I execute npm run seed in secondChance-backend
Then the secondChanceItems collection contains sixteen uniquely identified items
```

title: Run skeleton application
body:
**As a** developer
**I need** the application to start with a database health check
**So that** configuration errors are visible before serving users

### Details and assumptions
- Use environment variables, not committed credentials.
- Provide reproducible installation and startup commands.

### Acceptance criteria
```gherkin
Given MongoDB and a JWT secret are configured
When I start the backend
Then the health endpoint reports a connected database and the API listens on its configured port
```

title: Implement SecondChanceItems service API
body:
**As a** gift donor
**I need** item creation, browsing, editing and deletion
**So that** I can share useful possessions with new owners

### Details and assumptions
- GET list and detail remain public.
- Validate image uploads and assign unique IDs under concurrency.

### Acceptance criteria
```gherkin
Given I am authenticated
When I create a gift and later update or delete it
Then the changes persist and other users cannot edit my gift
```

title: Implement Search service API
body:
**As a** visitor
**I need** search by name, category, condition and age
**So that** I can find a suitable gift quickly

### Details and assumptions
- Escape text used in regular expressions.
- Invalid numeric filters return a clear validation error.

### Acceptance criteria
```gherkin
Given the seeded gifts are available
When I search for a name and category together
Then only gifts satisfying both filters are returned
```

title: Implement Sentiment Analysis service API
body:
**As a** visitor
**I need** a sentiment analysis endpoint
**So that** I can evaluate the tone of feedback

### Details and assumptions
- Use natural with its English sentiment vocabulary.
- Reject missing or excessively large sentences; no external AI API is required.

### Acceptance criteria
```gherkin
Given the sentiment service is running
When I submit a positive, negative or neutral sentence
Then the response includes a numerical sentimentScore and a matching sentiment label
```

title: Implement Registration backend service API
body:
**As a** new user
**I need** a registration form and endpoint
**So that** I can create my own account

### Details and assumptions
- Enforce a unique normalized email index.
- Never return password hashes in API responses.

### Acceptance criteria
```gherkin
Given I provide a name, unique valid email and acceptable password
When I register
Then the account is stored with a password hash and I receive an authenticated session
```

title: Implement Login backend service API
body:
**As a** registered user
**I need** secure login
**So that** I can access my account and create gifts

### Details and assumptions
- Reject incorrect credentials without revealing whether an account exists.
- Read JWT_SECRET from the runtime environment.

### Acceptance criteria
```gherkin
Given an account exists
When I submit the correct credentials
Then I receive a signed expiring JWT and my public profile
```

title: Implement User Profile backend service API
body:
**As a** registered user
**I need** a profile update endpoint
**So that** my displayed name stays current

### Details and assumptions
- Authorization comes from the signed token, not a request-supplied email.
- The update endpoint does not change an account email or password.

### Acceptance criteria
```gherkin
Given I am logged in
When I change my first and last name
Then the updated profile is saved for my JWT identity only
```

title: Integrate the frontend provided with the backend
body:
**As a** visitor
**I need** a complete browser experience
**So that** I can browse, search, register, sign in and manage my profile

### Details and assumptions
- Serve home.html at / and React routes below /app.
- Use relative same-origin API URLs and show request errors.

### Acceptance criteria
```gherkin
Given the production application is deployed
When I select Get Started on the landing page
Then the React application loads and uses the real backend services
```

title: Add CI/CD pipelines for backend services
body:
**As a** maintainer
**I need** automated tests and deployment checks
**So that** changes are verified before release

### Details and assumptions
- Use a real MongoDB service in CI.
- Preserve the completed workflow output as evidence; never manufacture a pass.

### Acceptance criteria
```gherkin
Given a commit is pushed or a pull request opened
When the CI workflow runs
Then MongoDB integration tests, sentiment tests, frontend build and container deployment smoke tests pass
```

title: Containerize the services and applications
body:
**As a** operator
**I need** reproducible containers
**So that** the same application can run outside the development machine

### Details and assumptions
- Use a multi-stage frontend build and a non-root application user.
- Keep database data and uploaded images in persistent volumes.

### Acceptance criteria
```gherkin
Given the source repository has been cloned
When I build the backend and sentiment Docker targets
Then both images build and run without requiring local node_modules
```

title: Deploy backend services
body:
**As a** operator
**I need** a running website with persistent storage
**So that** users can access the completed SecondChance application

### Details and assumptions
- Seed the database before starting the application.
- Capture real browser and curl evidence with visible deployment URLs.

### Acceptance criteria
```gherkin
Given the images and a random JWT secret are ready
When I start the Compose services
Then the landing page, gift APIs and sentiment proxy are reachable and healthy
```

title: Research authentication in Express
body:
**As a** maintainer
**I need** documented options for stronger account protection
**So that** future authentication changes have clear tradeoffs

### Details and assumptions
- Optional follow-up: expand authentication beyond the required course scope.
- Keep this research separate from the implemented registration, login and profile endpoints.

### Acceptance criteria
```gherkin
Given the baseline bcrypt and JWT authentication works
When I evaluate refresh-token rotation, rate limiting and account recovery
Then a follow-up design identifies implementation and testing requirements without claiming those features already exist
```
